local_vetting_points: Ask whether the clinic separates screening, diagnostic clarification, and full neuropsych testing instead of bundling everything into one vague service line.
Ask whether the written report includes practical recommendations for school, workplace, accommodations, or treatment planning.

Ask whether intake, testing, scoring, feedback, and report delivery are billed together or separately.

primary_city_decision_block.title: City-specific neuro evaluation decision checklist
items: Decide whether the question is ADHD, autism, learning, memory, concussion/TBI, or a broader differential evaluation.
Ask what the written report can support: school, work, therapy planning, medication discussion, or legal/medical documentation.
Compare intake-to-testing-to-report timeline, not only first appointment availability.
Ask whether the provider routinely works with the age group and evaluation purpose you need.
Ask whether pricing reflects screening only, full testing, collateral review, feedback, and written recommendations.
Confirm insurance, superbill, reimbursement, prior-authorization, and records requirements before scheduling.

testing_scope_notes: Ask whether the clinic offers screening, diagnostic clarification, ADHD-focused testing, autism-focused testing, or a broader differential workup.
Testing depth should match the real decision you need to make.
Use a symptom-to-evaluation-path decision tree: ADHD, autism, learning disability, TBI, mood, memory, or broader neuropsych testing.
insurance_reimbursement_notes: Ask whether the clinic is in-network, private pay with superbills, or fully out-of-network with no reimbursement support.
Do not assume testing is covered just because an intake visit is covered.
Ask whether coding, documentation, or superbill language is designed to support reimbursement.
Ask for CPT/superbill/prior authorization expectations before booking; coverage and reimbursement are plan-specific.
adult_vs_child_fit: Confirm whether the clinician routinely evaluates adults, children, or both, and whether the testing approach changes by age group.
report_turnaround_notes: Ask when the written report is delivered, whether the feedback session is included, and whether accommodations-ready language is part of the standard report.
If the report is needed for school or workplace decisions, ask what usually delays final delivery.
Ask when the written report and feedback session are delivered and whether the report supports school, work, medical, or accommodation decisions.
